preconditions.description: The lengths of s1 and s2 must be equal.

preconditions.expression: all(c in 'xy' for c in s1) and all(c in 'xy' for c in s2)
preconditions.description: Both s1 and s2 must consist of only the characters 'x' and 'y'.

postconditions.expression: result == -1 if not is_possible else min_swaps
postconditions.description: The result is -1 if it's impossible to make s1 and s2 equal, otherwise it's the minimum number of swaps required.
